title: Carousel
body: Move through a simple revision plan, one week at a time.
instruction: Use the previous and next controls to move between slides.

_items.title: Week 1 — test yourself
_items.caption: Sit a past paper early. It feels uncomfortable, but it shows you exactly where the gaps are.

_items.title: Week 2 — close the gaps
_items.caption: Spend your time on the topics you got wrong, not the ones you already know.

_items.title: Week 3 — practise to time
_items.caption: Answer whole questions under exam conditions, so the real thing holds no surprises.
